title: IP Bind Guard
description: This project adds a verification with you IP-address
body:
## Features

- `/bindip` – binds your current IP address to your username. After that, no one can log into your account from a different IP.
- `/unbindip` – removes the IP binding from your account.

**Tip:** You don't need to type your IP manually – the plugin automatically uses the IP you're connecting from.
